title: Scoped proof: exact 3-ADD minimum for PR1221's R439 frame-509 endpoint
body:
## Result

For the fixed R439 frame-509 Boolean endpoint on `(a,b,h,c)=(33,38,468,77)`, the minimum in the scalar one-destination ADD model is exactly **3**. The endpoint changes three distinct destinations, so fewer than three scalar ADDs cannot realize it. PR #1221's three-ADD word attains the lower bound. An exact four-register CNOT census has 1, 12, 97 and 626 distinct maps at lengths 0–3, with exactly three target words at length 3.

The four-ADD and three-ADD integer transfers are different by exactly `2 e_468 e_33^T`; this is a Boolean endpoint result, not integer-map equality.

## Relationship to concurrent work

Hanson Sun's open [PR #1221](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1221) provides the witness and explicitly makes no minimum claim. Concurrent [PR #1344](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1344) independently verifies the maps, full splice, and invoice, also without claiming a minimum. This package adds the local lower bound and exact shortest-word classification; it does not repeat PR #1344's full replay.

## Provenance and scope

- Base commit: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`.
- Selected conditional result stays `κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000`; the complex supplier remains binding.
- PR #1221 head `6deda901721316fcb61c6e2a6dd6b537de183452`; parent circuit PR #973 head `c05dc72734c25dd069077157224d4dd30c6e8c19`; selected PR #589 head `a5afc8c6169ea61ba7c51dfd3cade02cc7b13b46` on PR #555.
- Source pins and overlap notes are in `research/r439-b509-local-minimality-seed06/`.

This does not establish a shortest factorization for the full frame-509 block, reprove H1–H5, establish hosted supplier admission, change the paid recursive profile, or claim a new κ.

## Reproduction and checks

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/r439-b509-local-minimality-seed06/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/r439-b509-local-minimality-seed06/test_package.py -v
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-b509-local-minimality-seed06 --check-only
```

The verifier prints `PASS_R439_B509_LOCAL_MINIMALITY minimum=3 length3_words=3 maps=1,12,97,626 boolean_inputs=16 integer_delta=2e_h_e_a no_new_kappa`. Four focused tests pass, and the package pin check prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`. Local verification used Python 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is not installed locally, so I could not run the registered Python 3.12 replay in this session.
